title: Manuscript Transcription: Diplomatic Ground Truth, HTR & LLMs
query: How effective are Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) platforms like Transkribus and large language models compared to manual diplomatic transcription in generating accurate text from historical manuscripts?

results.title: Unlocking the archives: Using large language models to transcribe handwritten historical documents
results.authors_venue_year: Unlocking the archives: Using large language models to transcribe handwritten historical documentsM Humphries, LC Leddy, Q Downton… - Historical Methods: A …, 2025 - Taylor & FrancisDemonstrates that Large Language Models (LLMs) significantly outperform specialized Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) software, such as Transkribus, in transcribing historical documents, achieving up to 32% lower Word Error Rates.Near-Human Accuracy with LLMs: Explains that combining LLMs for initial transcription and subsequent correction achieves near-human levels of accuracy, with Character Error Rates as low as 1.8% and Word Error Rates of 3.5%.Specialized HTR Accuracy: Notes that HTR models like those used in Transkribus are highly accurate when trained for a specific handwriting style, often achieving word-level accuracy between 85% and 95%.Save Cite Cited by 61 Related articles All 8 versions  [PDF] ach.org

results.title: Between the Lines: A Comparative Analysis of AI vs. Human Transcription of Lin Yutang's Bilingual Handwritten Notebooks
results.authors_venue_year: Between the Lines: A Comparative Analysis of AI vs. Human Transcription of Lin Yutang's Bilingual Handwritten NotebooksG Yang - From Manuscript to Megabyte: Building Sustainable …, 2026 - anthology.ach.orgCompares three HTR systems (Transkribus base, Transkribus fine-tuned, and a transformer-based model) with three expert human transcribers on 50 pages of Lin Yutang’s bilingual handwritten notebooks.Quantifies Accuracy Difference: Determines that HTR systems achieved a mean Character Error Rate (CER) of 17.84% compared to 3.18% for human transcribers, showing significantly lower accuracy for the automated methods.Proposes Hybrid Workflow Effectiveness: Finds that a hybrid workflow combining HTR with confidence-based human post-correction can achieve near-human performance (2.14% CER) at a significantly lower cost and higher throughput than purely manual transcription.Save Cite Related articles  View as HTML [PDF] arxiv.org

results.title: An HTR-LLM Workflow for High-Accuracy Transcription and Analysis of Abbreviated Latin Court Hand
results.authors_venue_year: An HTR-LLM Workflow for High-Accuracy Transcription and Analysis of Abbreviated Latin Court HandJD Isom - arXiv preprint arXiv:2507.04132, 2025 - arxiv.orgAchieves high accuracy in transcription by using a hybrid, multi-stage process that leverages an initial Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) model output as a grounded baseline for subsequent Large Language Model (LLM) post-correction, resulting in a Word Error Rate (WER) of 2–7%.Automated Multi-Stage Workflow: Develops a four-stage workflow that automates the most laborious aspects of transcription, moving from an HTR-generated baseline to multimodal LLM post-correction, text expansion into full scholarly Latin, and finally Named-Entity Correction.Diplomatic Transcription Quality: Produces a diplomatically faithful, non-expanded transcription in the first stage using the HTR model, which captures abbreviations as seen on the source page, setting up the foundation for a high-quality transcription that can be compared to manual diplomatic efforts.Save Cite Related articles All 2 versions  View as HTML [PDF] arxiv.org

results.title: Impact of Iterative Fine-Tuning on Transcription Accuracy in Complex Historical Sanskrit Manuscripts
results.authors_venue_year: Impact of Iterative Fine-Tuning on Transcription Accuracy in Complex Historical Sanskrit ManuscriptsK Chincholikar, K Gopalan, M Hasabnis - arXiv preprint arXiv:2608.18696, 2026 - arxiv.orgIndicates that Multi-Modal Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with OCR on historical documents that have complex, dense layouts and non-standard appearances due to a distribution shift from their pre-training data and data scarcity.Transkribus Platform: Mentions Transkribus as a service platform designed for the transcription, recognition, and retrieval of historical documents, suggesting it is a relevant comparison platform.LLM Diplomatic Transcription Benchmarking: Evaluates transcription accuracy using standard metrics like TextEdit and Page-CER on diplomatic Unicode Devanagari transcriptions requested from LLMs like Gemini, OpenAI, and Claude.Save Cite Related articles  View as HTML [PDF] reference-global.com

results.title: Collaborative workflows for handwritten text recognition in under-resourced manuscript collections
results.authors_venue_year: Collaborative workflows for handwritten text recognition in under-resourced manuscript collectionsM Meelen, RM Griffiths - Journal of Open Humanities Data, 2025 - reference-global.comProposes a collaborative workflow leveraging existing layout recognition and HTR models and tools, including Transkribus, with iterative model training and error analysis, to improve transcription accuracy for under-resourced languages and scripts.LLM Limitations: Explains that using Large Language Models (LLMs) for post-correction is not suitable when diplomatic transcriptions of challenging texts with complex abbreviations are required, which is a limitation compared to manual transcription or specific HTR/OCR tools.HTR Correction vs Manual: Compares two transcription methods in a pilot study: one team performing manual transcription from scratch to create new Ground Truth, and another team correcting the automatic transcriptions generated by HTR to streamline processing efforts.Save Cite Cited by 2 Related articles All 10 versions  No full text available View as HTML [PDF] acm.orgFull View

results.title: A User Perspective on HTR Methods for the Automatic Transcription of Rare Scripts: The Case of Codex Runicus
results.authors_venue_year: A User Perspective on HTR Methods for the Automatic Transcription of Rare Scripts: The Case of Codex RunicusMA Souibgui, A Bensalah, J Chen, A Fornés… - ACM Journal on …, 2023 - dl.acm.orgCompares and analyzes different transcription methods, including a fully manual transcription, to raise conclusions and provide recommendations for scholars interested in using automatic transcription tools.Performance Evaluation: Evaluates the performance of various transcription methods in a real-use case of a medieval manuscript written in runic script (Codex Runicus).HTR Limitations for Rare Scripts: Notes that current Handwritten Text Recognition systems, which often rely on deep learning, are too constraining for documents in rare scripts with few labeled training data available, resulting in decreased performance.Save Cite Cited by 14 Related articles All 4 versions  No full text available [PDF] emerald.com

results.title: Benchmarking large language models for handwritten text recognition
results.authors_venue_year: Benchmarking large language models for handwritten text recognitionG Crosilla, L Klic, G Colavizza - Journal of Documentation, 2025 - emerald.comExplores the applicability of Large Language Models (LLMs) in Handwritten Text Recognition (HTR) as a solution to manual transcriptions which are time-consuming and require significant human effort.Performance on Modern Handwriting: Compares proprietary LLM models, like Claude Sonnet 3.5, which exhibit the best performance on modern handwriting, with HTR platforms like Transkribus, noting that the performance comparison on historical documents is inconsistent.Historical Documents Limitations: Notes that LLMs and Transkribus models still require improvement in recognizing historical handwritten documents in languages other than English.Save Cite Cited by 33 Related articles All 8 versions  No full text available [PDF] springer.comCheck for full text @ X

results.title: Data-efficient handwritten text recognition of diplomatic historical text
results.authors_venue_year: Data-efficient handwritten text recognition of diplomatic historical textM Mayr, K Neumeier, J Krenz, S Bürcky… - Multimedia Tools and …, 2025 - SpringerExplores the possibility of automatically recognizing diplomatic transcriptions of texts written in Middle High German, presenting outcomes that are slightly inferior to those achieved with basic transcriptions.Quantitative Performance Results: Achieves a Character Error Rate (CER) of 9.39% for diplomatic transcription without expanded abbreviations and 12.07% with expanded abbreviations, significantly outperforming baseline errors of 14.26% and 68.21%, respectively.HTR Platform and Model Comparison: Mentions using Transkribus to semi-automatically extract text line images from historical documents and notes that TrOCR, a large model, often struggles or underperforms compared to a smaller Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) for historical documents, especially in a low-data regime.Save Cite Cited by 5 Related articles All 6 versions  [PDF] preprints.orgCheck for full text @ X

results.title: Churro: Making history readable with an open-weight large vision-language model for high-accuracy, low-cost historical text recognition
